content.title: Ralston Central Park & Splash Pad
content.summary: Ralston Central Park features a splash pad that operates normally during Stage 1 drought restrictions, utilizing recycled water to support conservation efforts. The park, located at 5850 Garrison Street, is open daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. from May 23 to September 7, 2026, and offers various amenities including playgrounds, walking paths, and picnic areas, with a focus on community use and sustainability.
content.body:

## Splash Pad Information

### Stage 1 Drought Information

**The Splash Pad will run as normal during Stage 1 drought restrictions.**This could change should the City be required to move to Stage 2 drought restrictions. The Splash Pad uses water that is captured, treated, recycled and used again similar to a swimming pool. This means we can run the Splash Pad and still meet our water conservation goals. Learn more about [Stage 1 water restrictions](/1499).

- **Location**: 5850 Garrison Street
- **Hours**: Daily from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m.
- **Schedule**: Open Memorial Day weekend, Saturday, May 23, 2026 through Labor Day weekend, Monday, Sept. 7, 2026
- **Maintenance operations:**The splash pad may be non-functional for approximately 10 minutes, three times per day during maintenance operations. In the event the features are not running but not related to maintenance operations, **please call Apex Park and Recreation District at 303-424-2739.**
- **No****dogs**are allowed on the splash pad. They are welcome in the park on a leash.
- **Restroom hours**: 7 am to 8:30 pm - May 1 through Labor Day

Portalets are available from the day after Labor Day through April 30 due to the restrooms being winterized.

## Pavilion and Tables Information

The pavilions and tables at Ralston Central Park and Splash Pad cannot be reserved. They are first-come, first-served and are intended to be shared by our community.

- Ralston Central Park is not intended for large private gatherings.
- Tables should not be held for later gatherings.
- Please use no more than four tables per group.
- Be considerate and limit your time at the tables so that others have the opportunity to use them as well.
- Please clean up once you're done. Throw away smaller items in the trash bins on site and dispose of larger, bulkier items elsewhere.
- For private gatherings, consider renting one of our [reservable pavilions](/518).

**Additional Information**:

- Bouncy castles and other inflatable gyms and obstacle courses are **prohibited**.
- Please remove all decorations and event debris prior to leaving the park.

For more information call 720-898-7410.

## General Ralston Central Park Information

The 20-acre park features the following amenities:

- Walking paths and direction connection to the Ralston Creek Trail
- Two age-appropriate playgrounds with poured-in-place surfacing
- Indoor restrooms that open 7 a.m. to 8:30 p.m. May 1 through Labor Day
- Sand volleyball pit
- Large covered picnic pavilion with seating for 100
- Hernor Family Memorial Garden
- 89-vehicle parking lot

## Interesting Project Facts

- The site was formally known as North Jeffco Park was completely redesigned and opened as Ralston Central Park in 2016
- The park's outdoor buildings were custom-designed to accommodate the contour of the site's floodplain.
- The Hernor Family Memorial Garden, the restroom and maintenance building, and the covered picnic pavilion feature design details unique to Arvada.
- More than 200,000 cubic yards of soil were removed, and the City relocated about 20,000 cubic yards to nearby Wolff Park, saving $150,000 on the project.
- The memorial trees located within the project's boundaries were relocated either within the new park itself or to Wolff Park, the skate park at the Apex Center, or the Lutz/Stenger Sports Complex.
- The park's sustainability features include LED lighting, landscaping that utilizes native prairie grass, and plants that require no irrigation.
